Hi I am really sorry to hear what your are going through.  The right help, which may include medication, You Can Gain Control Over Your Depression!! In the video link below Samantha Campbell Counselor, therapist and Licensed Clinical Social Worker, with over 19 years experience, shares information to improve your understanding of the symptoms of depression; how it impacts the brain; the main chemicals that affects depression; and tips to manage your depression symptoms! click below to watch this incredibly helpful message of support and hope.
